name: Fin.foldl_const
statement:
theorem Fin.foldl_const (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → α) (init : α) :
  Fin.foldl n (fun _ i => f i) init = match n with
    | 0 => init
    | n + 1 => f (.last n)

name: Fin.foldl_const_succ
statement:
theorem Fin.foldl_const_succ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin (n + 1) → α) (init : α) :
    Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun _ i => f i) init = f (.last n)

name: Fin.foldl_const_zero
statement:
theorem Fin.foldl_const_zero (f : Fin 0 → α) (init : α) :
    Fin.foldl 0 (fun _ i => f i) init = init

name: cast_apply
statement:
theorem cast_apply {α β β' : Type} (h : β = β') (f : α → β) (x : α) :
    (cast (h ▸ rfl) f : α → β') x = cast (h ▸ rfl) (f x)

name: cast_apply'
statement:
theorem cast_apply' {α α' β : Type} (h : α = α') (f : α → β) (x : α') :
    (cast (h ▸ rfl) f : α' → β) x = f (cast (h ▸ rfl) x : α)

name: cast_fst
statement:
theorem cast_fst {α α' β : Type} (h : α = α') (p : α × β) :
    (cast h p.1 : α') = (cast (h ▸ rfl) p : α' × β).1

name: cast_snd
statement:
theorem cast_snd {α β β' : Type} (h : β = β') (p : α × β) :
    (cast h p.2 : β') = (cast (h ▸ rfl) p : α × β').2

name: fst_cast
statement:
theorem fst_cast {α β β' : Type} (h : β = β') (p : α × β) :
    (cast (h ▸ rfl) p : α × β').1 = p.1

name: snd_cast
statement:
theorem snd_cast {α α' β : Type} (h : α = α') (p : α × β) :
    (cast (h ▸ rfl) p : α' × β).2 = p.2
